directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay commenting on the importance of building trust between teachers and students. You can cite examples to illustrate your views. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200words.
sample_essay:
Building trust between teachers and students is of utmost significance in the educational process. To begin with, trust can create a positive learning environment. When students trust their teachers, they are more likely to actively participate in class discussions and ask questions without fear of being criticized. For example, in a math class, if students trust their teacher, they will readily share their thought-processes even when they make mistakes, which helps them learn more effectively.

In addition, trust enhances the quality of teaching. Teachers who are trusted by students can better understand their needs and adjust teaching methods accordingly. A teacher who has established trust with students may notice a student's declining performance early and offer timely help, such as providing extra tutoring or suggesting appropriate learning strategies.

Furthermore, trust between teachers and students can foster long-term personal growth. A trusting relationship can inspire students to develop good values and attitudes. For instance, a trusted teacher can serve as a role model, guiding students to be honest, responsible, and respectful.

In conclusion, building trust between teachers and students is essential as it not only promotes efficient learning and teaching but also contributes to students' overall development.
